title: 第2章 家传祖物
content_zh:
苍风岭下，怪人静静的看着陆云，眼中露出一丝笑意。此时的陆云，一身淡蓝色的长衫，双手背负，英俊的脸上，带着三分笑意，风采迷人。眼光清澈如水，隐含着一缕神秘，十分的吸引人。整个人看上去就宛如江南才子一般，弱不禁风，给人一种纤细秀美的感觉。

怪人淡淡笑道：“十二年了，你今天终于学有所成。我一身的本领，你都已经尽数学去，虽然火候还差得远，但只要努力，将来总有追上我的一天。我之一身所学，博杂无比，十二年的时间，你能将我一身数百年的修为全部学去，那也是世间绝无仅有的事情。你这一生，充满了变异与不确定，将来你能否与天争命，那就要看你自己的了，谁也帮不了你。现在你要离去了，我就告诉你几件事情，将来遇上了你要紧记。”说完微微停下，神情怪异的看着他，似乎隐藏着什么秘密。

陆云开口笑道：“师傅有话只管讲，不用顾及太多，这里只有我们两人，没有别人。”说完淡然一笑，隐隐中含着一丝邪异，十分不易看清晰。

怪人微微沉思了一下，开口道：“第一，我传你的一切法诀，包括了道家、佛家、儒家、魔宗、鬼宗五派的绝技，你要切记不可轻易施展，不然会给你带来麻烦。这五派的法诀中，以道家的‘太玄裂天道’与佛家的‘心禅不灭诀’最为霸道。儒家的‘浩然天罡’最为刚猛，魔宗的‘心欲无痕’最为玄奇，鬼宗的‘化魂大法’最为歹毒。十二年的时间，你都已经学成，虽然都只是小成，但对于同等年龄的人来说，你是绝无仅有的高绝了。

第二，天下之大，修真派别之多，数之不尽。每一个门派都有其精华之处，值得学习。但由于几千来，门户之见越来越深，彼此相互敌对，使得不少门派都落莫了。但天下间最有名的五派六院你也得要小心。我希望你在取回祖物后，可以到西蜀的易园去，学习那里的东西。那里也有其神秘之处，你将来如果要去的话，就要记住我今天的话。

易园身为天下六院之一，是六院中最奇特的一处，因为他那里招收的学员分两种，一是修真之人，二是普通学子，专门育人中华千古文学。其他五院都只收修真之人，这也就是为什么易园在六院中排名最后，但却最受人欢迎的地方。易园在修真界中，以‘易经’而闻名天下，最出名的绝技就是‘易天十二法诀’，据说学成后可以易天改命。易园有一镇山之宝，名为‘移天尺’是流传千古的神器，非同寻常。

另外我还知道一个易园的秘密，易园中有一套法诀，名为‘五雷正天诀’，从易园创始之初，就没有人炼成，你将来要是有机会，记得一定要学成那套功法。那套法诀最厉害的地方在于，它可以斩杀世间一切妖魔鬼怪，是世间一切妖魔的克星，至刚至阳之极，可以毁灭一切阴森鬼气之物，十分的霸道。

第三，近来我每夜都在观看苍穹星辰，发现一个不祥之兆，天下即将大乱，妖孽必将现身。最多三年的时间，天下就将有一场异变，那时恐怕整个修真界都将受到影响，全会陷入一片腥风血雨之中。你出去后要牢记这一场劫难，小心留意。

第四，你一直没有兵器，有空的时候，还是找一把好了。修真界里，兵器分为四种，分别是神器、仙器、灵器与法器。法器是最常见的，也是最普通的，而神器整个天下间也仅有几件而已，是可遇不可求的东西。对于仙器，那全是一些得道飞升的修真之士留下的兵器，十分的霸道，极为罕见，天地间也不多。

而所谓的灵器，就是修真之人，在炼制了法器后，再进一步修炼而成。炼器的法诀有很多，最常见的有两种。第一种是正道人士用的方法，就是以自己的修为，将修为灵力或是法力强行注入自己原本的法器之中，使其威力大增，进而跨越法器的界线，升为灵器。这种方法修炼的灵器，威力十分强大，可惜太费修为了，没有坚强意志的修真之人，是不愿意费力去炼制灵器的。

第二种是魔道的炼器之法，一般是在自己的法器中，强行加入生魂或是一些妖物的元神，以此来增加自己法器的威力，从而达到灵器的威力。这是修真之人最常用的，可惜却歹毒无比，被正道所不齿。魔道中人却最是爱用这种方法，因为这种方法最快最省力，远比正道人士修炼灵器快多了。

最后一点，是我多年的经验，你也最好记住。那就是世间万物，除了人外，也有其他一些灵物在修真，希望幻化为人，修道成仙。但它们在人类的眼中，却是异类，被人称只为妖魔鬼怪。这些灵异之物，也同人一样，是有善恶之分，并非所有的妖魔鬼怪都是坏的，就如同不是所有的人都是好人一般。所以你将来出道时，莫要被世人那些斩妖除魔的话所蒙蔽，要自己分辨对方的善恶，然后再做出决定。世间最邪恶的不是那些异灵，而是人类自己，这句话你要牢记。好了，其他我就不多说，将来你自己慢慢会明白的，你去吧，有空可以回来看看我。”

陆云仔细的品味着师傅的话，微微笑道：“放心吧，我不会与那些人一样的。师傅好好保重，云儿就去了。这一方水土，就拜托师傅照看了。”说完微微看了看四周，似乎有一种不舍的情绪。

怪人道：“这一点不用你说，我也明白，去吧。苍天之大，万物之奇，将来你会明白很多现在你不懂的道理。修真之路，逆天而行，不是每个人都那么顺利。这条路不好走，希望你好好保重自己。去吧，天地万物，转眼云烟，世间一切，皆为虚幻。”说完微微望着天际，不再看陆云。

陆云微微一礼，算是报答十二年的师徒之情。转过身，看了看远方，陆云身体瞬间腾空而起，化作天际一道流云，如蓝色星光，瞬间消失无影。好玄好神奇，真是让人难以置信。怪人看着天际，微微一叹，转身进洞而去。山风吹过，阵阵花香四溢，一切又恢复了平静。

一座挺拔的山峰上，突然落下一个蓝色身影，无声无息，没有人知道他是从什么地方出现的，就那样凭空现身，十分神秘。静静的看着山下，这蓝衣少年二十左右，十分英俊，正是陆云。陆云脸上带着一丝笑容，身体微微晃动，如行云流水般穿梭在山林里，速度快捷无比。

不多时，陆云来到一个深谷之上。看着下面，陆云微微皱眉道：“应该就是这里了。为什么我们陆家的祖坟地，会选择在这里呢？这里可是一个绝阴之地，阴气极重，恐怕下面隐藏着不少凶邪之物吧。”静静的看着深谷，陆云眼中慢慢流露出一丝惊骇之色，神情十分怪异。

微微抬头，看着天际，陆云沉思起来。每一次当陆云沉思之时，他总是爱看着天际，似乎在对着苍天怒吼，表示出自己决不屈服的坚强意志。再一次看着深谷，陆云自语道：“看来当年我们陆家的祖先，也必是位旷绝天地的奇才，不然他怎么会将祖坟藏在这条龙脉的龙眼之上，从而保住了陆家百世的昌盛，真是非同凡想。”

陆云身体微微一晃，慢慢的落了下去，速度不快，显得很慢。同时陆云身上，瞬间爆发出一道刺目的红色光芒，有如烈日当空，十分耀眼。为了安全，陆云还是施展出了儒家的“浩然天罡”，牢牢的护住自己的身体。慢慢下落，陆云发现四周出现了无数的奇形怪兽，全是些从来没有见过的异兽，有的身体高大无比，有的体长惊人，全部都牢牢的盯住陆云，宛如在看着自己的食物一般。

陆云仔细的打量了一阵，还好，全是些初入灵异阶段的弱小异物，对陆云还无法造成威胁。深谷很深，直有数百丈距离。陆云越往下落，感觉四周的阴气越重，那谷底似乎隐隐透露出一股凶猛的阴森邪气，使得陆云心生警惕。陆云心里明白，这谷底一定隐藏着修真的异灵，且十分的强大，因为那股气息十分明显，凶猛中带着邪恶，看样子不是善灵，得小心。

看着地面慢慢的接近，陆云提起全身功力，仔细的留心注视着四周的动静，不停的找寻那邪恶的阴森之气的来源。可惜陆云看了一会，谷底四周全是寸草不生的怪石林立，根本无法藏身，但却没有见到那异灵。这让陆云心里一愣，接着又是一惊，好厉害的修真异灵，竟然懂得隐身。

陆云身体微微立在离地三尺的半空中。周身红光爆射，瞬间将谷底照得一片血红，所有的东西都看得清清楚楚。只是什么也没有，奇怪。四周看了一眼，在左边不远处，有一个丈高的山洞，显得格外阴森诡异，充满了邪气。陆云眼神微疑，双手一引法诀，顿时双手出现一青一金两道奇光，微微向下一压，瞬间地面就沉塌下去。紧接着惊人的气劲瞬间外散，地面被纷纷翻起，形成一个以陆云为中心，飞速向四周扩散的真气波，瞬间狂卷一切。半空中雷声轰鸣，宛如天崩地裂般，气势惊人。

谷底阴风四起，夹着怪异的阴啸声，宛如地狱的阴魂在怒吼。一团黑色的气息瞬间笼罩在陆云头顶，只见黑云中，一条三头灵蛇翻滚不息，身体竟然长约百丈，在空中宛如一团黑云，压得四周一片阴暗，光线暗淡。三头灵蛇三颗巨大的蛇头，每一个都有十丈粗大，六只眼睛就像六个灯笼一般，在阴暗的深谷里，发出血红色的妖异光芒，骇人之极。三条红信每一条都长有数丈，吞吐不息，阵阵阴风从三张巨口中狂卷而出，带着阴森的毒气，侵蚀着一切物体。

陆云看着那庞然大物，心里也惊骇极了，这么大的妖灵可是第一次见到，真是骇人。仔细回想师傅曾经提过，关于三头灵蛇的叙述，陆云心里有种不妙的感觉。据说这三头灵蛇是世间极为罕见的灵物，早就已经绝种，想不到在这里还能见到这种洪荒异兽，真是不可思议。传说此物乃龙之异种，寿命可达数千年，甚至上万年。它的三颗蛇头中，含着三种不同的邪异性质，可以吐出烈火、寒冰与绝毒之气，是天下最罕见的邪灵。此物最是聪明，修炼远比一般异灵快很多，属于世间罕见的妖灵与邪灵之列，任何人遇上，都是难以活命。

陆云想不到自己今天就遇上，真是不知道该高兴还是该叹息。陆云看了一下那个山洞，还好洞口不大，想来这三头灵蛇庞大的身体是进不去的，自己如今惟有进入躲避，看能否避开它的攻击。想到这里，陆云身体在空中一折，飞速的直射那个山洞。

半空中，三头灵蛇六只眼睛闪着寒光，巨尾一甩，全力向陆云扫去。只见一道狂风顿起，夹着开山裂石之威，奇快无比的狂卷陆云的身体。陆云人在空中，感觉到那股强大的劲道扫来，心里大惊，双手全力后扬，狠狠的狂劈两掌。一来希望可以阻止三头灵蛇的进攻，二来想借反震之力，加速前进，早一点进洞躲避。

阴暗的深谷里，一声震天巨响，四周巨石纷飞，夹着骇人的气势，深深的震撼着天地。陆云以一步之遥抢先射进山洞，躲过了三头灵蛇那狂横绝世的一击。身后，山洞两旁的石壁，被三头灵蛇巨大的蛇尾击中，顿时发出惊天巨响，整个山谷都为之一颤，坚硬的石壁顿时被击破一个大洞，怪石横飞，那声势惊人无比。

陆云射入洞中，心里狂跳不已，站在地上，感觉整个山谷都在颤抖，陆云眼中射出惊骇之色。陆云自语道：“这么大的妖灵，恐怕就是师傅来，也得退避三舍，只有逃命的份，想不到竟然被我遇上了，真是运气好的气人啊！也不知道我们陆家祖先为什么选择这里，这里固然是龙脉宝地，可也太偏僻了。妖灵无数，谁敢来取那东西，真是害人。我要不是还有点本事，今天就玩完了。”一边说一边仔细的打量着四周的情况，心里异常的警惕。洞外三头灵蛇传来怪异的啸声，十分惊心，但陆云却不理不问。

山洞不小，竟然深不见底。顺着山洞一直走下去，越往下，阴森之气越重，陆云心里越是不安，仿佛有什么凶兽等在那下面等着自己。四周小型的岔道不少，每一个岔洞中，都藏着无数奇异的异灵，形状各异，大小不一。陆云此时身上的“浩然天罡”已经换成了鬼宗的“化魂大法”，一团黑色的气罩慢慢的笼罩住陆云全身，邪异诡秘的鬼宗奇术散发着凶邪之气，使得所有的异灵都远远回避，不敢靠近他的身体。因为他的身上含着一股，吞噬一切的邪恶气息，令这些异灵心里恐惧。

时间慢慢过去，陆云走了好一会，终于来到一个数十丈大的大洞里。这里看样子是山洞的腹地了，因为四周有三条通道，成三角形，通往别处。大洞正中，有一颗拳头大的明珠，照得四周一片明亮。只见正中有一石棺，四周分列着四尊石像，全是兵器在手的兵卫模样，各自严阵以待，刀剑皆齐。在这四尊兵卫外面，又出现了八副图案，分别刻在地上，全是一些相貌凶恶的恶魔图形，宛如传说中的厉鬼，十分的骇人。

陆云看着四周，仔细的打量着这个大洞，很快就发现地上白骨成堆，看样子最少都有上百具尸骨。这使得陆云格外小心，知道这里一定暗藏着绝秘，不然不会有那么多人跑来送死。静静的绕着中间的石棺走了一圈，陆云脸上出现了一丝惊异。这个地方灵气十足，却没有半点邪气，先前感觉到的凶邪之气，此时没有一点痕迹，真是怪事情。而这里所有的灵气，都汇聚在那座石棺之上，到底那里面隐藏着什么东西呢？不解，神秘。

仔细的看着那八副图案与那四尊兵卫，陆云明白这里面一定隐藏着什么秘密与凶险，不然是不会一直耸立在里面，这么多年都没有被人得去。沉思了一会，陆云决定出手一试，看看这阵势的威力如何，也好再做打算。

陆云右手运起儒家的“浩然天罡”，顿时一股阳刚之极，威猛无比的红光出现在陆云手上。陆云右手一挥，强大的掌力夹着开山裂石之威力，瞬间攻击那中间的石棺。同时陆云身体快速旋转一百八十度，整个人出现在了另一边，周身红光闪烁，牢牢的护住自己的身体。

只见陆云那强大无比的刚猛一掌，瞬间击中了石棺。可就在离石棺还有三尺距离时，地上的八个恶魔图案，瞬间发出耀眼的光芒，形成一道气罩，将石棺牢牢的保护在里面。而同时里面的四尊兵卫，瞬间活了起来，各自挥动兵器，瞬间爆发出四色璀璨的光华，组成一个四种颜色的神奇真气罩，循环流动不息，强行的挡住了陆云那强大的一击。

陆云脸色一变，微微抬头沉思起来。看样子想要突破这两道阵法结界，不是那么容易的事情。这石棺里，应该就是陆家祖先留藏宝物的地方，究竟里面隐藏着什么宝物呢？为什么守得这么严呢？陆云心里充满了好奇。围着石棺不停的走动，陆云周身五色光华流动，全力施展魔宗的“心欲无痕”，以真气探查这座奇阵的奥秘。陆云不停的加快真气的频率，先是每一息一百到二百次，这时候已经加速到，每一息一千二百次，可仍然无法进入那座神奇的阵法里，丝毫也探查不到那石棺的任何气息。

陆云周身爆发出璀璨的光华，此时他已经施展出了十层功力，真气的频率瞬间加速道每息二千四百次，这已经是他的极限了，再快就不行了。如果这一次还不行，陆云就没有办法了。他所习练的五种法诀中，就以魔宗的“心欲无痕”最为快速，真气的频率可以达到最高，所以他选择以这套法诀，来探查这阵法的神奇。

记得师傅说过，他老人家施展这套法诀时，最快可以达到每息六万八千六百次，是世间都罕见的。而以陆云现在的实力来说，能够达到每息二千四百次，已经是相当了不起了。陆云慢慢的将真气频率保持在二千四百次，真气开始慢慢的流动，慢慢的穿过阵法的空隙，一步步的探查着阵法的神秘。

时间慢慢的过去，陆云已经满头大汗，身体开始出现虚弱的表现，这是真气消耗过多的现象。终于在又坚持了一会后，陆云整个人顿时无力的倒下了，躺在地上大口的喘息着，汗水湿透了他的全身衣服。微微的看着那座神奇的阵法，陆云眼中露出一丝笑意，终于还是查清楚了这阵法的秘密，可以有机会破解它，穿越这道防御，进入其中了。

At the foot of Cangfeng Ridge, the weirdo looked at Lu Yun quietly, with a hint of smile in his eyes.At this time, Lu Yun was wearing a light blue gown, with his hands behind his back, a smile on his handsome face, and a charming style.His eyes are as clear as water, with a hint of mystery hidden in them, which is very attractive.The whole person looks like a talented man from the south of the Yangtze River. He is frail and gives people a slender and beautiful feeling.

The weirdo smiled faintly and said: "It has been twelve years, and you have finally learned something today. You have learned all my skills. Although you are still far from perfect, as long as you work hard, you will catch up with me one day. What I have learned is extremely comprehensive. In twelve years, you can learn all my hundreds of years of cultivation. That is the world's best.This is a unique thing in this world. Your life is full of changes and uncertainties.Whether you can compete with God in the future depends on you. No one can help you.Now that you are leaving, I will tell you a few things to keep in mind when you meet me in the future." After speaking, he paused slightly and looked at him with a strange expression, as if he was hiding some secret.

Lu Yun smiled and said: "Master, just talk if you have anything to say, don't worry too much, there are only two of us here, no one else." After speaking, he smiled calmly, with a hint of evil in it, which was very difficult to see clearly.

The weirdo pondered for a moment and then said: "First, all the techniques I teach you include the unique skills of the five sects of Taoism, Buddhism, Confucianism, Demon Sect, and Ghost Sect. You must remember not to use them easily, otherwise it will bring you trouble. Among the techniques of these five sects, Taoism's 'Tai Xuan Splits the Way of Heaven' and Buddhism's 'HeartThe "Zen Immortal Technique" is the most domineering.The Confucian "Haoran Tiangang" is the most powerful, the Demon Sect's "Heartless Desire" is the most mysterious, and the Ghost Sect's "Soul Transformation Technique" is the most vicious.You have learned all of them in twelve years. Although they are only minor achievements, for people of the same age, you are uniquely advanced.

Second, the world is so big and there are so many cultivation sects that they are countless.Every sect has its essence and is worth learning.However, over the past few thousand years, the sects have become increasingly divided and hostile to each other, causing many sects to fall into decline.But you also have to be careful with the Five Factions and Sixth Academy, which are the most famous in the world.I hope that after you get back the ancestral things, you can go to Yiyuan in Western Shu and learn the things there.There is also its own mystery there. If you go there in the future, you must remember what I said today.

As one of the six academies in the world, Yi Yuan is the most unique place among the six academies, because the students he recruits there are divided into two types, one is a cultivator, and the other is an ordinary student, specializing in educating people in Chinese literature through the ages.The other five courtyards only accept cultivators, which is why Yiyuan ranks last among the six courtyards, but is the most popular place.In the world of cultivation, Yi Yuan is famous for the 'Book of Changes'. His most famous skill is the 'Twelve Techniques of Yi Tian', which is said to be able to change one's destiny after learning it.There is a mountain-holding treasure in Yiyuan, called the "Yitian Ruler". It is an extraordinary artifact that has been passed down through the ages.

In addition, I also know a secret of Yi Yuan. There is a set of techniques in Yi Yuan called the "Five Thunder Zhengtian Jue". Since the beginning of Yi Yuan, no one has perfected it. If you have the opportunity in the future, remember to learn that set of techniques.The most powerful thing about that set of techniques is that it can kill all monsters and ghosts in the world. It is the nemesis of all monsters in the world. It is extremely strong and can destroy all gloomy and ghostly things. It is very domineering.

Third, I have been watching the stars in the sky every night recently, and I have discovered an ominous sign. The world is about to be in chaos, and evildoers will definitely appear.In three years at most, there will be a sudden change in the world. At that time, I am afraid that the entire world of cultivation will be affected, and the whole world will be plunged into a bloody storm.When you go out, you should keep this disaster in mind and pay careful attention.

Fourth, you have never had a weapon, so you might as well find one when you have time.In the world of cultivation, weapons are divided into four types, namely artifacts, immortal weapons, spiritual weapons and magic weapons.Magical weapons are the most common and common, and there are only a few divine weapons in the world. They are something that can only be encountered but not sought.As for the immortal weapons, they are all weapons left behind by some cultivators who have achieved enlightenment and ascended to heaven. They are very overbearing, extremely rare, and there are not many in the world.

The so-called spiritual weapon is made by a cultivator who refines the magical weapon and then further cultivates it.There are many methods for refining weapons, the most common ones are two.The first is a method used by righteous people, which is to use one's own cultivation to forcibly inject the spiritual power or magic power into one's original magic weapon, greatly increasing its power, and then crossing the boundary of the magic weapon to become a spiritual weapon.The spiritual weapons cultivated in this way are very powerful, but unfortunately it takes too much effort. Cultivators without a strong will are not willing to go to the trouble of refining spiritual weapons.

The second method is the magic weapon refining method, which usually involves forcibly adding living souls or the souls of some monsters into one's own magic weapon, in order to increase the power of one's own magic weapon and achieve the power of a spiritual weapon.This is most commonly used by cultivators, but unfortunately it is extremely vicious and is despised by the righteous way.People in the demonic path love to use this method the most, because this method is the fastest and most labor-saving, and it is much faster than the people of the righteous path who can cultivate spiritual weapons.

The last point is my many years of experience, and you'd better remember it.That is all things in the world. In addition to humans, there are also some other spiritual beings who are cultivating, hoping to transform into humans and practice Taoism to become immortals.But in the eyes of humans, they are aliens and are only called monsters and monsters.These supernatural beings, like humans, are divided into good and evil. Not all monsters and monsters are bad, just like not all people are good people.So when you make your debut in the future, don't be blinded by the world's words about slaying demons and demons. You must distinguish the good and evil of the other person yourself, and then make a decision.The most evil thing in the world is not those alien spirits, but humans themselves. You must remember this sentence.Okay, I won’t say much else. You will understand it yourself in the future. Go ahead and come back to see me when you have time."

Lu Yun carefully tasted his master's words and smiled slightly: "Don't worry, I won't be the same as those people. Master, take care, Yun'er will go. I will ask the master to take care of this land and water." After saying that, he looked around slightly, seeming to have a feeling of reluctance.

The weird man said: "You don't need to tell me this, I understand it, go ahead. The sky is huge and all things are amazing. In the future, you will understand many things that you don't understand now. The road of cultivation is against the sky, and not everyone is so smooth. This road is not easy to walk. I hope you take good care of yourself. Go, everything in the world, clouds and smoke in the blink of an eye, everything in the world is an illusion." After speaking, he looked at the sky slightly, no longer looking at Lu Yun.

Lu Yun gave a slight salute, which was regarded as repaying the affection of master and apprentice for twelve years.Turning around and looking into the distance, Lu Yun's body instantly rose into the sky and turned into a stream of clouds in the sky, like blue starlight, and disappeared instantly.It's so mysterious and magical, it's really unbelievable.The weirdo looked at the sky, sighed slightly, turned around and walked into the cave.The mountain breeze blew by, the fragrance of flowers overflowed, and everything became calm again.

On a tall mountain peak, a blue figure suddenly fell down silently. No one knew where he appeared from. He appeared out of thin air like that, which was very mysterious.Looking quietly at the bottom of the mountain, this young man in blue, about 20 years old, very handsome, is Lu Yun.There was a smile on Lu Yun's face, his body swayed slightly, and he shuttled through the mountains and forests like flowing clouds and flowing water, extremely fast.

Not long after, Lu Yun came to a deep valley.Looking down, Lu Yun frowned slightly and said, "It should be here. Why did our Lu family choose this place for their ancestral graveyard? This is a place of absolute gloom, and the gloom is extremely heavy. I'm afraid there are many evil things hidden underneath." Looking quietly at the deep valley, Lu Yun slowly showed a hint of horror in his eyes, with a very strange expression.

Raising his head slightly and looking at the sky, Lu Yun began to think deeply.Every time when Lu Yun was meditating, he always liked to look at the sky, as if he was roaring at the sky, showing his strong will to never give in.Looking at the deep valley again, Lu Yun said to himself: "It seems that the ancestor of our Lu family must have been a genius in the world. Otherwise, how could he hide his ancestral grave on the dragon's eye of this dragon vein, thereby preserving the prosperity of the Lu family for hundreds of generations? It is really extraordinary."

Lu Yun's body swayed slightly and slowly fell down. The speed was not fast and seemed very slow.At the same time, Lu Yun's body instantly erupted with a dazzling red light, which was as dazzling as the scorching sun in the sky.For the sake of safety, Lu Yun still used the Confucian "Haoran Tiangang" to firmly protect his body.Slowly falling, Lu Yun found countless strange monsters appearing around him. They were all strange beasts that he had never seen before. Some were extremely tall, and some were astonishingly long. All of them were staring at Lu Yun, as if they were looking at their own food.

Lu Yun looked at them carefully for a while. Fortunately, they were all weak foreign objects that had just entered the supernatural stage and could not pose a threat to Lu Yun.The canyon is very deep, hundreds of feet away.The lower Lu Yun fell, the heavier the gloomy air around him seemed to be. There seemed to be a fierce and sinister evil energy faintly revealed at the bottom of the valley, which made Lu Yun feel wary.Lu Yun knew in his heart that there must be a cultivation spirit hidden at the bottom of the valley, and it was very powerful, because the aura was very obvious, ferocious and evil, and it didn't look like a good spirit, so be careful.

Seeing the ground slowly approaching, Lu Yun used all his strength and carefully watched the movements around him, constantly looking for the source of the evil and gloomy aura.Unfortunately, Lu Yun looked around for a while and saw that the valley bottom was surrounded by strange rocks with no grass growing on it, making it impossible to hide, but he did not see the strange spirit.This made Lu Yun stunned for a moment, and then he was shocked again. Such a powerful spiritual spirit actually knew how to become invisible.

Lu Yun's body stood slightly in mid-air three feet above the ground.A burst of red light shot out from his body, instantly illuminating the valley floor with blood red, and everything could be seen clearly.Just nothing, weird.I looked around and saw that not far to the left, there was a cave 10 feet high, which looked particularly eerie and full of evil spirits.Lu Yun's eyes were suspicious, and he invoked the magic formula with both hands. Two strange lights, one green and one gold, suddenly appeared in his hands. He pressed down slightly, and the ground suddenly sank.Immediately afterwards, the astonishing energy spread out instantly, and the ground was turned up one after another, forming a wave of true energy with Lu Yun as the center, rapidly spreading to all directions, and sweeping everything in an instant.Thunder roared in mid-air, as if the sky was shattering and the earth was shattering. The momentum was astonishing.

There was a dark wind blowing at the bottom of the valley, accompanied by a strange howling sound, like the roaring ghosts of hell.A black aura instantly enveloped Lu Yun's head. In the black cloud, he saw a three-headed spiritual snake rolling endlessly. Its body was about a hundred feet long. It was like a black cloud in the sky, making the surrounding area dark and dim.The three huge snake heads of the three-headed spirit snake are each ten feet thick. The six eyes are like six lanterns. In the dark valley, they emit a blood-red monster light, which is extremely frightening.Each of the three red letters was several feet long, and they were spitting out endlessly. Gusts of sinister wind blew out from the three huge mouths, carrying a gloomy poisonous gas, corroding all objects.

Lu Yun looked at the behemoth and was horrified in his heart. This was the first time he saw such a big monster. It was really scary.After carefully recalling what his master once mentioned about the three-headed spiritual snake, Lu Yun felt something bad in his heart.It is said that these three-headed spiritual snakes are extremely rare spiritual creatures in the world and have been extinct for a long time. It is incredible to think that such ancient and strange beasts can still be seen here.Legend has it that this creature is a different species of dragon, with a lifespan of thousands or even tens of thousands of years.Its three snake heads contain three different evil properties. It can spit out fire, ice and poisonous gas. It is the rarest evil spirit in the world.This creature is the most intelligent, and its cultivation is much faster than ordinary supernatural spirits. It is one of the rare demon spirits and evil spirits in the world. Anyone who encounters it will find it difficult to survive.

Lu Yun didn't expect that he would meet him today, and he really didn't know whether to be happy or sigh.Lu Yun took a look at the cave. Fortunately, the entrance was not big. He thought that the huge body of the three-headed spiritual snake would not be able to enter. Now he had no choice but to enter and hide to see if he could avoid its attack.Thinking of this, Lu Yun's body folded in the air and shot straight into the cave at high speed.

In mid-air, the six eyes of the three-headed spiritual snake flashed with cold light. It flicked its giant tail and swept towards Lu Yun with all its strength.I saw a strong wind suddenly rising, carrying the power of cracking mountains and cracking rocks, and swept Lu Yun's body with extremely fast speed.Lu Yunren was in the air and felt the powerful force coming towards him. He was shocked, raised his hands back with all his strength, and struck hard with two palms.Firstly, I hope to stop the three-headed spiritual snake's attack, and secondly, I want to use the power of the counterattack to speed up and get into the hole earlier to avoid it.

In the dark valley, there was a loud noise, and huge rocks flew around, with a terrifying momentum, deeply shaking the world.Lu Yun shot into the cave first with one step away, avoiding the crazy attack of the three-headed spirit snake.
